transit.description: Hash-only node: re-runs check and test when a dependency's sources change.

build.description: The Go hub (hub#build, console embedded) and the web bundle.

check.description: tsc (Go is type-checked by lint and test).

lint.description: Go static checks (scripts/go-check.sh). Biome is the root task biome:check.

format.description: gofumpt (Biome is the root task biome:fix). `-- --check` only verifies.

test.description: bun test, and go test with the race detector.

gen.description: TS client types from packages/api-client/openapi.json. That spec and charts/kuben/crds/kuben.dev_all.yaml are frozen contracts: Rust generated them up to 1.2, nothing regenerates them now, and the Go tests pin the server and the embedded CRDs to them.

size.description: Size budgets: web bundle (size-limit) and the hub binary.

//#biome:check.description: Biome lint and format check over the whole repository.

//#biome:fix.description: Biome format, organize imports and safe fixes.

hub#build.description: The Go hub with the console embedded (scripts/go-build.sh).

hub#dev.description: The API with every role, in dev mode (Vite proxies /api to it).

hub#size.description: Binary size budget on the hub as it ships (static, console embedded).

hub#e2e.description: End-to-end suite against the current kube context (e.g. kind).
